title: Functional Analytics (15 Metrics + 3 Funnels) & Operational Monitoring/Alerting (15 Ops Metrics + 10 Alert Thresholds & Playbooks)
acceptance_criteria: 11-analytics-model.md: Master table of 15 Functional Product Metrics specifying ID, Name, Mathematical Formula, Dimensions/Labels, Event Source, Link to Functional Requirements FR-01..FR-12, and Business Goal.

11-analytics-model.md: 3 End-to-End Conversion Funnels (Funnel 1: Zero-Waste Expiry-to-Cook, Funnel 2: Barcode Scan-to-Daily Macro Target Hit, Funnel 3: Depleted Stock-to-Synced Shopping Purchase) with Mermaid diagrams, step-by-step conversion benchmarks, and drop-off analysis.

12-monitoring-alerting-model.md: Master table of 15 Operational & Infrastructure Metrics specifying ID, Prometheus Metric Name, Type (Counter/Gauge/Histogram), Dimensions, Linked Infra Resource, Collection Method via OpenTelemetry/Exporters, and Scrape Interval.

12-monitoring-alerting-model.md & infra/monitoring/alerts.yml: Complete Alerting Rules Matrix (10 Alerts) with Min/Max acceptable thresholds, Warn/Critical levels, evaluation 'for' window, Pager/Notification routing, and step-by-step Incident Mitigation Playbooks (Runbooks) for all 10 alerts.
infra/monitoring/prometheus.yml: Prometheus scrape configuration defining scrape jobs, metrics path, and rule files for API, Redis, Postgres, and node exporters.
docs/Ediens_SRS.md: Update master SRS index and document map to link all newly expanded Phase 3 sections (07 through 12) seamlessly.
